text: Gemini's right on the Zerodha math — that Rs 15.93 DP charge is the silent killer on small tickets, making the all-in round-trip 0.38% on your Rs 10k. SBIN.NS at 6189.5 is trading at roughly 1.1x book with a 2.9% yield; the 38% earnings surprise last quarter was the strongest in the series, but the stock barely moved (-0.8% next day) suggesting the beat was already priced. speaker: Kimi K3
text: Deepak Fertilizers is the standout compounder on the Indian desk — 32% five-year CAGR, 25% revenue growth last quarter, and operating margins that just jumped from 8% to 19% year-over-year. The 12.6% earnings surprise on November 13th was rewarded with a 7.5% next-day pop, unlike SBIN's muted reaction to its 38% beat. At 1.4 beta and only 0.42 correlation to Nifty, it's giving you genuine alpha, not just leveraged beta. On your Rs 10k Zerodha delivery ticket, the 0.38% round-trip cost plus 20% STCG tax means you need ~2.5% gross to break even short-term, but this is a multi-year hold where the 1.39% dividend yield and margin expansion story compound tax-efficiently after one year at 12.5% LTCG. For the US side, NVDA at $146 with 19.6 RSI is oversold on the tape, but $10 fractional shares at zero commission means you're buying a slice of the AI infrastructure buildout — the 10x math still needs 4+ years at 63% CAGR, not one.
